about_history_p1: Founded in 1960 in Italy, COMET has established itself as a major player in the design and manufacture of aerial platforms and height-access systems.
about_history_p2: Building on its globally recognized Italian know-how, COMET combines technical innovation, manufacturing quality, and robustness to offer reliable and powerful equipment.
about_history_p3: Today present in over 130 countries, COMET supports professionals across all sectors: industrial maintenance, public lighting, telecommunications, facade cleaning, events, and more.
